title: He Makes $27K/Month Sending Text Messages
channel: Chris Koerner on The Koerner Office Podcast
promo_conflict: Aaron promotes his own referral-pipeline company, Hyros, its website and blueprint, and discusses agency partnerships.

stated_problem.quote: there's so many small businesses that have had cold calls from lead genen companies that it doesn't go well.
stated_problem.speaker: Aaron Fuks

idea.name: Managed referral pipelines for home service businesses
idea.one_liner: Find trade businesses with complementary customers, introduce them around active projects, and manage the resulting referral relationships for package and monthly fees.
idea.customer: Home service businesses such as painters, siding companies, electricians and general contractors.
idea.offer: Source potential referral partners and live bid opportunities, qualify and connect businesses, then track and nurture their relationships.
idea.revenue_model: Upfront packages for appointments or partnerships, plus monthly relationship management; initially charged per appointment.

key_quotes.quote: We build referral pipelines for home service businesses.
We pulled a huge list of all the roofers in our area and we sent a text to every single one of them asking if they needed a specialized service like an insurance bid on siding.
And also I'm not selling the job. I'm selling the relationship.

claims.claim: The initial fee was about $150 per appointment.
claims.quote: It was like 150 bucks. Okay.

claims.claim: A potential referral could lead to jobs worth $10,000, $20,000 or $50,000, multiple times a year, with the contractor making 40–50% profit.
claims.quote: And as I realized that every person that he talked to could bring him 10, 20, $50,000 jobs multiple times a year where he's making, you know, 40, 50% profits.

claims.quote: Like he wanted 20 30 appointments a month.

claims.quote: And so we can call, text thousands of companies, get either a sales guy or a project manager or a business owner on the phone and then connect them with our client.

claims.quote: It might look like, you know, $40 to $50,000 roofing and siding. The siding is maybe $15 to $20,000.

acquisition_channels.details: Initially called businesses from Google Maps; later called respondents after text campaigns and qualified opportunities.
Mass-texted trade businesses about partnerships and live bids, then called those who replied.
Built referral relationships and partnered with marketing agencies to reach their clients.
Used Google Maps to find business contacts.

ideas.delivery: The team uses public business data to identify complementary trades, contacts businesses by text and phone, qualifies live projects and potential partners, introduces the parties, and tracks and nurtures relationships in GoHighLevel.

uk_legal_risk.reason: The acquisition method relies on mass cold text messages. In the UK, unsolicited marketing SMS to individual subscribers and sole traders requires consent under PECR; the target trades may include sole traders. Cold calls must also screen TPS/CTPS.

ideas.other_uk_rules: UK GDPR applies when public listings contain personal data; identify a lawful basis and provide required privacy information. For cold email, restrict unsolicited marketing to corporate subscribers and include an opt-out.
